summary: rdfxvela@5.0.0: static pattern match on child_process + HTTP in cli.js without corroborated exfiltration evidence
details: Package ships a cli.js that imports child_process and performs an HTTP POST. Static pattern matching flagged the co-occurrence of child_process, a POST call, and identifier reads, but the traced data flow, destination host, and reachability at install/import time have not been confirmed. No specific installer-side secret path (env scraping, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser stores) or attacker-controlled destination is named in the available evidence. The pattern is consistent with either a CLI that shells out and calls a documented endpoint, or with a hostile exfiltration path — the evidence does not distinguish between them.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
